verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages describe user-defined dynamic rules that automatically provision or revoke access when roles change. They also describe custom workflows that fire on security threats and deliveries, offboarding events that automatically trigger device retrieval, and the explicit framing "You define the rules, Rippling runs the rest." Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the rule/workflow builder (trigger catalog, conditions, action types), any independent or hands-on corroboration, and specifics on cross-system workflow automation beyond marketing claims.
